headline: Binance Clients Withdraw $4.72B Following Cyberattack
summary: Binance clients withdrew $4.72 billion from the cryptocurrency exchange after it reopened following a cyberattack where hackers stole about $6.3 billion.
why: Binance is the world's largest cryptocurrency exchange by trading volume, and massive withdrawals highlight systemic operational and security risks in digital asset platforms.

impacts.name: Binance
impacts.why: The platform experienced massive capital outflows following a security breach.
impacts.baseline_rule: first recorded price at or after created_at (15-minute price recorder); end = first price at least 24 h later, within 48 h

why_moved: A major cyberattack and massive withdrawals directly trigger liquidity stress and loss of confidence in the affected crypto exchange.
